note: A dated log, not a single value. Each entry keeps the printed text, the official URL, and the retrieval time. A total is computed only when the rate is attached to a stay date.

rows.rate_printed_text: 'These rates will start as low as $119 and $209 and can be higher.' No calendar date is attached to either figure and the page does not say which property each figure applies to.
rows.resort_fee_text: There is a $55 resort fee per night stayed.
rows.room_tax_text: Clark County Room Tax 13.38% (official Venetian hotel terms).
rows.parking: Complimentary self-parking for players who play three hours or more (official poker page).
rows.cancellation_note: The poker-suite page does not print a cancellation deadline. It says the poker rate cannot be combined with other promotions and requires six hours of live cash play or a $300+ tournament buy-in per night stayed, or the rate is adjusted to the prevailing rate.
rows.qualification_requirement: Six hours of active live cash gameplay or a $300 or higher tournament buy-in per night stayed, completed before 2 a.m. of the last night stayed.
rows.booking_channel: Call 866.255.8936 and mention code EPOKR25 (printed on the official page).
rows.true_cost_note: Not computed: neither printed figure is attached to a stay date. The stated components are rate + $55 resort fee, taxed at 13.38%. At the printed low figure that arithmetic would be (119 + 55) x 1.1338, but the page does not attach $119 to any date, so no total is entered.
